svg.title: The scene agent's action and observation loop
svg.desc: A goal and live observation first go to the local model to choose a bounded plan. Python parses one action. The browser executes it using the same controls as the sliders, reads the result and appends it to history for the next turn. DONE requires fresh state and a separate model check. Failed checks return to the loop. Twelve decisions is the limit.

g.text: shape the world · one decision at a time
Read runtime result; append to history
one initial model call sets targets; other controls stay fixed
one JSON reply, no direct access to scene code
validate range, availability and observed revision
success, unchanged value or rejected action
DONE → fresh state + separate local-model check
YES + stable revision → complete · NO → feedback and repeat
12 decisions maximum · at most 25 model calls · human can stop
